title: 2026.46: The End of Jensen
summary: 黄仁勋交棒结束英伟达33年的时代，本期最值得读的一篇是 Stratechery 的 Jensen 终章解读。
summary_en: The note marks Jensen Huang’s leadership transition at Nvidia as the end of a 33-year era. It highlights Stratechery’s interpretation of Jensen’s final chapter as the most worthwhile reading in this issue, framing the handover as a significant close to a long-running chapter in the company’s history and a notable moment for its future.
body:
